verdict.rationale: Gusto ships an official, agent-oriented CLI (github.com/Gusto/gusto-cli). It offers OAuth and headless token auth, a stable JSON envelope in --agent mode, documented exit codes, --dry-run, and a human-in-the-loop --confirm write gate. It also includes a first-party AGENTS.md and bundled agent skills that auto-install into Claude Code, Cursor and similar tools, and probes verified the install endpoint on cli.gusto.com and a real release cadence (v0.1.0–v0.3.0). missing for 10: independent community or hands-on usage reports, and full command coverage (the pre-1.0 CLI only drafts payroll and has no run/submit command)
